title: Three-Day Moving Median Revenue
description:
For each day, compute the **median revenue of that day and the two calendar days before it** (a 3-day trailing window that shrinks at the start of the series).

**Table: daily_rev** — `sale_date`, `revenue`

Output columns: `sale_date`, `revenue`, `moving_median`. Order by `sale_date`.
solution_sql: SELECT d.sale_date, d.revenue, (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d2.revenue) FROM daily_rev d2 WHERE d2.sale_date BETWEEN d.sale_date - 2 AND d.sale_date) AS moving_median FROM daily_rev d ORDER BY d.sale_date
hints: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revenue) is the continuous median.
A correlated subquery filters rows where sale_date is between current_date - 2 and current_date.
explanation: Window contents: [10]; [10,20] interpolates to 15; [10,20,30]=20; [20,30,40]=30; [30,40,15]=30; [40,15,25]=25. PERCENTILE_CONT interpolates between the two central values when the window has an even count.
